mapper.sql: select id, name, type_id, platform_id, kind_id, icon, maintain, recommend, large_icon, effect, create_time, sort from game_info
mapper.select: select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, i.kind_id, i.platform_id from game_info i left join game_platform p on p.id = i.platform_id where i.effect = 1 and p.effect = 1 and i.type_id = #{typeId} order by i.sort asc

select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, i.kind_id, i.platform_id from game_info i left join game_platform p on p.id = i.platform_id where i.effect = 1 and p.effect = 1 and i.recommend = 1 and i.type_id = #{typeId} order by i.sort asc

select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, i.kind_id, i.platform_id from game_info i left join game_platform p on p.id = i.platform_id where i.effect = 1 and p.effect = 1 and i.recommend = 1 order by i.sort asc

select i.id, i.name, i.icon, i.maintain, i.recommend, i.large_icon, p.game_category, p.maintain platform_maintain, i.kind_id, i.platform_id from game_info i left join game_platform p on p.id = i.platform_id where i.effect = 1 and i.platform_id = #{platformId} and p.effect = 1 and i.type_id = #{typeId} order by i.sort asc

select t3.id, t3.name, t3.icon, t3.maintain, t3.large_icon, t3.kind_id from (select t2.* from (select distinct game_info_id from game_type_with where type_id = #{typeId}) t1 inner join (select id, name, type_id, icon,kind_id, maintain, recommend, large_icon, sort from game_info where effect = 1) t2 on t1.game_info_id = t2.id) t3 order by t3.sort asc
select id, name,icon ,platform_id as platformId,kind_id as kindId from game_info where effect = 1
